title: Companion native comparison media
description: On an isolated connected renderer fixture, inspect paired and single videos, then open ordinary evidence. No gate resolution or product visual approval. Shut down and delete owned proof resources after retaining receipts.

proofTargets.claim: Native comparison cards identify paired and single video captures.
Selected comparison media opens using its own viewer list.
Ordinary artifacts remain accessible after a comparison selection.

open.intent: Open the selected renderer fixture through its native decision route.

paired-video.intent: Identify both paired captures as videos.

single-video.intent: Identify the unpaired capture as a video.

capture-previews.intent: Record video previews in the existing comparison cards.

open-paired-after.intent: Open the selected After capture from its own comparison list.

paired-title.intent: Confirm the viewer opened the selected After video.

paired-index.intent: Use the same one-item list for visibility and navigation.

capture-paired.intent: Record the selected After video in the native viewer.

close-paired.intent: Return to the decision without changing its evidence.

show-raw.intent: Expand supporting files for the ordinary image.

open-ordinary.intent: Open an ordinary image after viewing comparison media.

ordinary-title.intent: Confirm the ordinary image uses its own artifact gallery.

capture-ordinary.intent: Record the ordinary image after the comparison viewer closes.

open-single.intent: Open the unpaired After video from its existing card.

single-title.intent: Confirm the unpaired video opens from the selected list.

close-single.intent: Close the viewer without resolving the gate.
